objective: Complete one selected live attached-estate journey from verified attachment and capability discovery through read-only inventory, one authorized mutation, reconciliation, exact restore semantics, and detach; M9_INFRASTRUCTURE_ESTATE_OPERATIONAL_JOURNEY_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: Adapter presence or simulated inventory is presented as live estate management, or detach mutates external resources or loses retained IOI truth.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

required_work: Select one design-partner adapter and prove the complete live journey.
implementation_actions: Implement source-specific adapter behind source-neutral lifecycle interfaces.
positive_proof: One live estate completes attach-to-detach with current capabilities and receipts.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Wrong host identity, stale capability, external drift, provider loss, ambiguous effect, unsupported operation, and detach safety fail closed.
compatibility_and_migration: Provider-native ids remain evidence; canonical ids and receipts survive detach.
remaining_nonclaims: Managing an estate does not make IOI its underlying VMM.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Return to read-only or detach when live identity/currentness/authority cannot be proven.
